recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, vertically-oriented photograph of a porcelain doll leaning against a weathered headstone in a dark, wooded setting, framed by a wide cream-colored border with elegant, muted-gray serif typography above and below the image.
coreVisualRelationships: The central photograph acts as a window into a dark, moody scene against a flat, bright cream background.
The muted gray of the text echoes the shadows and stone textures within the photograph.
The wide margins create a sense of preciousness and historical distance.
coreInvariants: Centered rectangular photograph with a thin inner frame
Classical serif typography with swash details

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photograph is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white dress of the doll provides the highest point of contrast and the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down into the framed image, and rests on the bottom text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely high use of negative space in the cream border to isolate and elevate the central image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background for the outer frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep forest greens and earthy browns within the photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted slate gray for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; the background is high-value while the photograph is low-value, creating a 'keyhole' effect.

letterConstructionRules: Occasional decorative swashes on terminal characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swash on the final 't' or 'g' that curls back toward the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both top and bottom text to maintain formal symmetry.
graphicDevices: Thin yellow-gold inner stroke around the photograph

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary classical, literary feel.
For a more stylized, 70s-era folk aesthetic with swashes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square canvas with a wide cream border. In the center, place a vertical rectangular photo of an antique porcelain doll in a white dress sitting against a stone monument in a dark, twilight forest. The photo should have a thin, subtle gold border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of centered text in a muted slate gray serif font. Place the primary name at the top and the title at the bottom, ensuring the bottom text is stacked in two lines.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm cream rather than stark white?
Is the text a soft gray rather than black?
Is the central image moody and low-light?
Are the serifs on the font sharp and classical?

adjustableVariables: Subject of the central photograph (e.g., a different vintage object)
Specific swash intensity on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title

mustAchieve: A sense of quiet, historical melancholy

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not touch the central image.
Check that the photograph looks like a physical print mounted on the cardstock.
Verify the cream background has a slight paper-like texture.
Confirm the typography feels integrated and not like a modern digital overlay.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a wide, textured paper-stock border with a centered, dark-toned 'window' photograph and frame it with elegant, muted-color serif display type.
